setup.zh: 从冀州往东南，路到濮水就平了。水清，岸边桑树成行。东边一片晴天，却一直在打雷。一个老人坐在岸边钓鱼，不回头。
setup.en: South-east from Ji the road flattens at the Pu. Clear water, a line of mulberries along the bank. The eastern sky is clear, and it will not stop thundering. An old man sits fishing on the bank and does not turn round.

recap.zh: 濮水边晴天打雷；钓鱼的老人说，雷泽的雷四十天没停了。
recap.en: On the Pu it thundered under a clear sky; an old angler said the thunder over Lake Lei had not stopped in forty days.

text.zh: 雷里头有东西。第二鼎在东边，水底下。
text.en: There is something inside the thunder. The second cauldron lies east, under the water.

text.zh: 老人头也不回：雷泽的雷，四十天没停了。要问路，去濮阳。
text.en: The old man does not look up: the thunder over Lake Lei has not stopped in forty days. If you want the road, ask in Puyang.

exits.means: goes to the town, follows the river downstream, agrees to ask there

text.zh: 你沿濮水往下游。濮阳的城门口围着一群人，都在看一张告示。
text.en: You follow the Pu downstream. A crowd stands at the gate of Puyang, all reading one notice.

exits.means: goes straight east toward the thunder now, tries to reach the lake directly

text.zh: 你往东走了半里，雷声震得胸口发闷，脚下的路淹在水里。
text.en: Half a li east the thunder sits on your chest, and the road goes under water.

text.zh: 先去镇上。总有人知道路。
text.en: Town first. Someone there knows the way.

exits.means: asks the fisherman who he is, about the envoys, or why he will not turn round

text.zh: 老人说：楚国来的两个大夫在这儿站了三天，请他去做官。他说，他宁可做泥里的乌龟，拖着尾巴爬。你问雷泽，他抬了抬钓竿：往东，跟着雷走。
text.en: The old man says: two envoys from Chu stood here three days to make him a minister. He would rather be a tortoise dragging its tail in the mud. You ask about Lake Lei; he lifts his rod: east, follow the thunder.
